Sauna When Sick

The research is about prevention, not cure. A small 1990 trial found people who used a sauna regularly had about half as many colds in the last three months of the study, and Finnish cohort data link 2 or more sessions a week with lower pneumonia risk. No good study shows a sauna shortens a cold you already have. With a mild head cold, a short, cooler session is usually fine; with a fever, body aches, vomiting or diarrhea, skip it.
